notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
We're back with another update, packed with enhancements and features to elevate your gameplay experience. Here's a breakdown of what we've implemented:




Speed Increase: We've boosted the movement speed in both the camp and village areas, allowing for quicker navigation.

Reflections in the Apartment: To add a touch of realism and depth, we've introduced reflections in the apartment setting.

Slide Puzzle Assistance: Recognizing that some players might find the slide puzzle challenging, it will now auto-complete after a certain duration to assist those who might be stuck.

Run Button: By popular demand, we've added a run button, enabling the character to move faster when needed.

Mouse Sensitivity: We've reduced the default mouse sensitivity for a more controlled experience. 

However, if you prefer a different setting, you can easily adjust this from the game settings.

Your feedback drives our updates, and we're always eager to hear from you. Let us know how these changes impact your gameplay, and share any other suggestions you might have.

Thank you for your continued passion and support!

notes.title: Small Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to roll out another update for our game. We've listened to your feedback and made several enhancements to improve your gameplay experience. Here's what's new in this patch:

Objective List: Players can now access an objective list in-game. This will help you keep track of your tasks and know exactly what needs to be done next.

Mouse Freezing Fix: We've addressed the issue where the mouse would freeze upon entering a new area. This should now be resolved.

Camera Movement: Adjustments have been made to the camera movement to provide a smoother and more intuitive experience.

Graphical Adjustments: We've made several graphical tweaks to various levels, enhancing the visual appeal and overall aesthetics.

Settings: Fixed a problem with the AZERTY keyboard option and the controller use.

We're committed to continually refining Tatari to ensure the best possible experience for our players. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please keep it coming.

Thank you for being a part of our community!

notes.title: Small Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
We're excited to bring you a new patch update! Our team has been hard at work addressing feedback and making improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Here's a quick rundown of what's new:

Material Updates: We've adjusted the materials for certain objects, making them more distinct and noticeable.

Sound Fixes: Some sound issues have been addressed and fixed for a smoother audio experience.

Boundary Adjustments: We've fine-tuned some boundary sizes to ensure they align better with the game environment.

We always strive to provide the best experience for our players, and your feedback plays a crucial role in that. Please continue to share your thoughts and suggestions with us.

Thank you for your continued support and happy gaming!
